study type: Methodology validation study within a longitudinal cohort
exposure: Maternal self-reported premature rupture of membranes
outcome: Validity (alignment with published prevalence) of maternal self-reported data
cohort: Pregnant women and women at delivery recruited across Jamaica from July 1-30 September 2011, intending to form the Ja-Kids Longitudinal Study cohort.
finding: Maternal reporting showed good to moderate consistency for some indicators like previous C-section, pre-existing diabetes, and prior twin gestations, but only fair or poor agreement for many others, and prevalence rates were generally lower than published literature, suggesting caution when interpreting maternal reporting of pregnancy complications.
mod_finding: Previous C-section was one of the indicators that showed good to moderate reporting consistency (kappa = 0.681) between pregnancy and delivery.
